error.subscription_limit: Subscription usage limit reached. Try again after the limit resets.
error.ai_busy: An AI analysis is in progress, so this can't be done right now.
error.login_no_url: No sign-in URL was received. Try again or sign in from a terminal.

provider.persist: Save on this PC (Windows-protected). If unchecked, it's used only for this session.
provider.writeOnly: API keys are not shown again after entry, and are never written to logs or the screen.

sub.title: Subscription account
sub.notFound: Claude Code can't be found on this computer.
sub.installHint: Install Claude Code yourself following the official instructions, then click [Check again]. This app doesn't install it.
sub.unsupported: Claude Code {{version}} is not a supported version. Update to the latest version and check again.
sub.unknown: Couldn't check the sign-in status. Try clicking [Check again].
sub.waiting: Complete the account approval in your browser…
sub.urlHint: If the browser doesn't open, open the URL below yourself.
sub.codeHint: If the browser asks for a code, run claude auth login in a terminal to finish, then click [Check again].
sub.apiKeyEnv: Billed to the API key in this PC's environment variables. API usage is charged instead of the subscription limit.
sub.limits: Subscription usage limits apply, and background batch analysis of unanalyzed assets doesn't run in subscription mode. Only manual analysis and automatic analysis of new assets are used.

auto.needConsent: Available after you consent to sending data to external AI.
auto.backgroundHint: Slowly analyzes unanalyzed assets when the system is idle.
auto.scheduleHint: Analyzes only during set hours. If start and end are the same, it runs all day.
auto.timelineWrap: Analyzes daily from {{start}}:00 until {{end}}:00 the next day (past midnight).

transfer.metadataHint: Sends file name, date taken, type, duration, and custom metadata field values (only fields with values); absolute paths are never sent.

similarSettings.maxHint: The maximum number of media shown in the Similar tab.
similarSettings.bandNone: No limit — shows everything regardless of similarity.
similarSettings.minHint: Lower values also show less similar results. 0% means no limit. This model can rate unrelated images at 50–60%, so 70% or higher is recommended.

local.sttHint: Audio is processed only on this PC and never sent externally.
local.semanticHint: Finds images by the meaning of a sentence. Processed on this PC.
local.semanticNeedModels: Can be turned on after downloading the text search model (e5). The CLIP models for image similarity search are not required.

model.title: Local models
model.offline: Couldn't download because there's no internet connection. Connect and try again.

batch.hint: External analysis is skipped if no provider (API key) is available.

usage.title: Usage
usage.empty: No usage records for this period.

settings.title: Metadata fields
settings.limitReached: You can create up to {{max}} fields. To create a new field, delete an unused one first.
settings.note: All fields can be used as filters, and short text fields are also included in keyword search
settings.emptyDescription: Create fields for things you want to record per item, such as project, director of photography, or delivery date, then enter values and find items with filters.

dialog.createDescription: Set the name and type of the information field to enter for items.
dialog.editDescription: You can change the name and options.
dialog.nameDuplicate: A field with the same name already exists.
dialog.typeHint: The type can't be changed after creation.
dialog.typeLocked: The type can't be changed after creation. If you need a different type, create a new field.

option.duplicate: An option with the same name already exists.

deleteField.title: Delete field
deleteField.impact: Values deleted along with it: {{count}}. This can't be undone.
deleteField.impactNone: No values have been entered. A deleted field can't be restored.
deleteField.countError: Couldn't count the entered values. Deleting will also erase any entered values, and this can't be undone.

deleteOption.title: Delete option
deleteOption.impact: Values in use that will be cleared: {{count}}. This can't be undone.
deleteOption.countError: Couldn't count the values in use. Deleting will also clear values that use this option.

detail.title: Custom metadata
detail.noOptions: No options. Add them in Settings.

error.keywordTooLong: You can enter up to {{max}} characters.

bulk.hint: Current values aren't shown. Only fields you fill in or clear are applied to all selected items.
bulk.limit: You can assign up to {{max}} at a time. Please reduce your selection.

filter.title: Custom metadata
filter.dropped: Filter conditions using deleted fields or options were removed: {{count}}.
filter.keywordPlaceholder: Type a value and press Enter
filter.keywordHint: If you enter several values, items matching any of them are found. Case-insensitive.
